summary: Enjoy a kawaii farming game with Rilakkuma! Grow crops, decorate, and care!
description:
Rilakkuma Farm Game is Here!

・Grow crops and craft items in various facilities!
・Decorate your farm to make it even cuter!
・Enjoy a relaxing farm life with Rilakkuma and friends!

From San-X, creators of “Sumikkogurashi,” comes a charming and cute farm game featuring their beloved characters!

[Story]
One day, Rilakkuma and friends heard about a “buffet of endless snacks” and decided to visit a farm with fields to explore. However, the place was rundown and deserted. Inside a small house, they found a note and a book.

Driven by the promise of delicious snacks, Rilakkuma’s relaxing farm life begins!

[About the Game]
Join Rilakkuma and enjoy a laid-back farm game experience. Cultivate crops, design a cozy farm in a charming box garden style, and spend time with Rilakkuma and friends. Harvest crops to create snacks and meals, fulfill orders from the neighbors, and earn cute items to decorate your farm further.

This farm game lets you create your unique farm and share it with other users. Whether you love farming, gardening, or just relaxing with adorable characters, this game offers endless kawaii fun!

[Features]

・Farm and Customize: Tend to your crops, decorate your farm, and expand your land to unlock new areas.
・Adorable Animations: Watch exclusive animations of Rilakkuma and friends as they enjoy farm life.
・Box Garden Decoration: Collect items to create a dreamy farm, perfect for those who love gardening and box garden games.
・Farm and Ranch: Take care of animals, collect eggs, and expand your ranch for even more fun.
・Dress Up Characters: Dress up Rilakkuma and friends in adorable outfits to match events, seasons, or your personal style.

[Who Will Love This Game?]

・Fans of cute games, kawaii games, and San-X characters like Rilakkuma and Sumikkogurashi.
・Players who enjoy relaxing farm games, farming games, and crafting.
・Those who love decorating their own space in a box garden or farm-style game.
・Girls looking for cute games with fun dress-up elements.
・Anyone who wants a stress-free, soothing experience with adorable characters.
・Fans of gardening, farming, and creating unique spaces to share with others.

[Additional Fun Features]

・Seasonal Events: Participate in special events and earn limited-time decorations and outfits.
・Challenges and Goals: Complete missions to earn rewards and advance your farm.
・New Characters and Areas: Discover exciting updates with new friends and locations to explore.

Step into the world of farming, design your dream farm, and relax with Rilakkuma and friends in this kawaii game. Whether it’s tending crops, dressing up characters, or decorating your land, you’ll find joy in every moment.

Download now to start your relaxing and cute farm life adventure!

[Compatible Devices]
Android OS 5.0 or above
・ Some devices still may not be compatible despite fulfilling the above conditions, depending on hardware specifications or other conditions.
